description: This file defines the final utility class `WidgetWorker` within the package `org.apache.ofbiz.widget`. It provides various static helper methods for URI construction, HTML element creation, form handling, script parsing, context management, and parameter resolution, primarily used in web widget and interface management within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WidgetWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate URI construction, HTML element creation, form handling, script parsing, and context management for widgets in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildHyperlinkUri
methods.description: Constructs a URI based on target, type, parameters, and request context, handling intra- and inter-application links, content URLs, and security tokens.

methods.name: getContentUrl
methods.description: Generates a content URL with proper prefixing for content locations, considering the request context.

methods.name: makeHiddenFormLinkAnchorElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML anchor element for hidden form links, including optional confirmation dialogs and images.

methods.name: makeHiddenFormLinkFormElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML form element with hidden inputs for submitting data via POST to a specified target URI.

methods.name: makeLinkHiddenFormName
methods.description: Generates a unique form name based on context and form model, useful for identifying form submissions.

methods.name: determineAutoLinkType
methods.description: Determines whether a link should be rendered as a hidden form or anchor based on the target and configuration.

methods.name: getScriptLocation
methods.description: Extracts the location part of a combined script identifier based on a '#' separator.

methods.name: getScriptMethodName
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a combined script identifier, returning null if not present.

methods.name: getScreenStack
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a ScreenStack object within the widget rendering context.

methods.name: getJwtCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT callback identifier from the context, checking both main and parameters map.

methods.name: getPaginatorNumber
methods.description: Obtains the current paginator number from context, initializing if absent.

methods.name: incrementPaginatorNumber
methods.description: Increments the paginator number within the context and global context, respecting the 'NO_PAGINATOR' flag.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher instance from the context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance from the context.

methods.name: resolveParametersMapFromQueryString
methods.description: Parses a special query string from the context into a parameter map for use in requests.
